#### What's great

I really like the idea behind Paintit.ai. It’s one thing to have a picture of how you want a space to look in your head, but actually seeing it come to life makes a huge difference. Being able to experiment with different styles and make changes just by chatting with the AI feels really intuitive. I also like that you can start with an actual photo instead of imagining everything from scratch. Definitely an interesting tool with a lot of potential!

The new 360° interior views are especially exciting, allowing you to explore spaces from different angles. The ability to experiment with real paint brands, test wall colors, swap furniture, and refine designs through simple chat commands makes the creative process much faster and more intuitive. A great tool for exploring ideas and presenting concepts to clients!

### Cons of AI-Chat Interior Designer

 Some AI art generators such as Midjourney or Dalle-2 also allow users to use chat prompts to customize their image to exact specifications

## 6. ﻿RoomGPT

Cost: From $9 for 30 room redesigns

  

RoomGPT is an AI-powered interior design platform that provides personalized design recommendations and solutions for various spaces, using advanced computer vision and deep learning technology to generate results.

Within the platform, you can easily redesign a room with over 8 different themes and select up to four at any time. The tool will then generate results that match what you have specified.

### Pros of RoomGPT

 Easy and quick to use
 Can use multiple themes at once
 Developers can easily clone and deploy RoomGPT on their platform using Vercel [...] Cost: Free, $24 per month for Pro (150 credits)

  

If you’re looking for something a bit more interactive, then AI-Chat Interior Designer from CollovGPT might just be for you. The platform features a clean and easy-to-use interface that allows you to upload a photo of your room, then chat through the options.

You can ask it to generate a specific design style, customize the room layout or furniture, or design a room based on the image you uploaded. The platform provides you with recommended questions you can ask or you can go freestyle with your queries.

### Pros of AI-Chat Interior Designer

 Allows for deep customization of design ideas using natural language queries
 User-friendly and clear interface
 Recommended questions feature useful for first-time users [...] 1. Choose an AI-powered interior design tool that best matches your usage. Do you want the platform to help specify a design for you or would you rather be able to customize it using text commands or natural language queries like you would an AI chatbot?
2. Define your preferences. These can include your desired room, style, colors, furniture arrangement, budget, and other crucial elements. Some tools use pre-set styles you can select from the outset.
